name: Cassava bánh tằm
summary: Bánh tằm made from Củ Chi cassava flour.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động, on 6 Mar 2017, says the root is ground to flour and made into bánh tằm. Tuổi Trẻ, on 5 May 2024, names bánh tằm among orders at a juice stall.
howToEat: The root is ground to flour and made into bánh tằm. A second account names bánh tằm as an order and stops there.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cassava bánh tằm in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Bánh tằm made from Củ Chi cassava flour.
